answer: By the copper of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, rewards vest against future work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Each submission hangs on the orchard of a task receipt, and the wander is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
